title: Pan ga Nakereba Yakeba Ii
description: Tamaki Nagi suddenly finds herself taking over the bakery her grandmother left her. Behind the storeroom door her grandmother's will said must never be opened, she finds… Marie Antoinette? From the creator of Chii-chan no Oshinagaki comes a slightly magical story that connects a neighborhood bakery with 18th-century France.
author: Ooi Masakazu
